Rating: Not RatedLanguage: EnglishWords: 4,391Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 40

Summary: Bruce loved all his partners very much. He felt incredibly lucky to find so many wonderful people who were willing not just to work with him, but to spend their precious free time together as well. Bruce knew he wasn't fun like Hal and Ollie, and he did not have the easy charisma of Clark or Diana. His body was broken and scarred, more so than even the other human heroes. That was all to say: he was grateful that they included him. He knew they loved him, but he also knew he was not an easy person to love. That much had certainly been made clear by this point. So he tried to simplify things. He ignored his instincts and his anxieties, and he tried his best to make himself the partner the others deserved. Some times it was harder than others.
